Claim Notes

27 Jul 2025
Claim opened for a side impact collision at an intersection. Claimant reports a shoulder injury and is represented by
counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2 Aug 2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is named on it. Coverage was in force at the time of loss.
24 Aug 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the impact and describes
damage consistent with a side impact.
2 Sep 2025
Statements from two independent witnesses and the other driver all match the claimant's description of how the
collision occurred.
31 Oct 2025
Photographs of the vehicle show damage that lines up well with the reported impact point and direction of force.
2 Nov 2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney to confirm the medical authorization forms and request the initial treatment
records.
7 Nov 2025
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history and found no earlier damage to the areas affected in this collision.
13 Nov 2025
Medical records show a shoulder injury that fits the kind and force of a side impact. No prior treatment to the same
body area appears in the records we have obtained.
10 Dec 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of shoulder injury. Requested updated
treatment notes to understand the recovery timeline.
16 Dec 2025
Claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation, including the recorded statement and the
follow-up call with counsel present.
16 Jan 2026
Reviewed the file with no concerns about the timnig of the damage or the coverage period. Claim remains open
pending the updated treatment notes and the attorney's demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
